[id="extensions-langchain4j-ingest-usage"]
== Usage
The extension turns document ingestion into configuration. Declare a knowledge base (an _ingestion
pipeline_) and point it at a folder:

[source,properties]
----
quarkus.camel.ai.ingest.products.source.type=file
quarkus.camel.ai.ingest.products.source.directory=/data/docs
----

Every file found is parsed, split into segments, embedded with the application's `EmbeddingModel`
bean and written to its `EmbeddingStore` bean. When more than one store or model bean exists,
select them explicitly per pipeline:

[source,properties]
----
quarkus.camel.ai.ingest.products.embedding-store=products
quarkus.camel.ai.ingest.products.embedding-model=my-model
----

Documents can also be pushed from a Camel route or from code through the
`direct:ingest-<pipeline>` endpoint. The `CamelAiIngestDocumentId` header is required — a stable
document id is what later releases build update and delete semantics on:

[source,java]
----
producerTemplate.requestBodyAndHeader("direct:ingest-products", text,
        IngestHeaders.DOCUMENT_ID, "manuals/warranty.pdf", IngestResult.class);
----

[IMPORTANT]
====
This extension is a *preview* and currently supports `mode=append` only: documents are only ever
added. A restart re-ingests the corpus, an edited document does not replace its previous version
and there is no deletion. It is intended for development and for in-memory or disposable stores.
Synchronisation (`mode=sync` — update, replace, restart-safety) arrives in a later release.
====


[id="extensions-langchain4j-ingest-quarkus-langchain4j-bom"]
== LangChain4j usage

=== Dependency management

In order to ensure alignment across all Quarkus and LangChain4j related dependencies, it is recommended to import the LangChain4j BOM as below:
[source,xml,subs=attributes+]
----
<dependencyManagement>
  <dependencies>
    <dependency>
      <groupId>dev.langchain4j</groupId>
      <artifactId>langchain4j-bom</artifactId>
      <version>{langchain4j-version}</version>
      <type>pom</type>
      <scope>import</scope>
    </dependency>
  </dependencies>
  ...
</dependencyManagement>
----

Note that the import order is paramount when using maven `dependencyManagement`.
As such, one might need to import the `langchain4j-bom` before other related Camel and Quarkus BOMs.

=== Quarkus LangChain4j support

WARNING: At present, this extension is neither tested with nor intended to be used in conjunction with any Quarkus LangChain4j extensions.
Consequently, both JVM and native modes may exhibit unexpected behaviour or fail to function correctly in such configurations.
